ImageDescription.value: On Tokyo leave from Korea, 1410845 Private (Pte) Kenneth (Ken) Alfred Walker (left), of Rockhampton, Qld, and of the 1st Battalion, The Royal Australian Regiment (1RAR), touches the statue commemorating the dog which waited two years at a Tokyo railway station after his master's death. 4327 Pte Rex Herbert Stevens, of Barmera, SA, and of 1RAR, prepares to take a photograph.
